'''Caralain''' was one of the 24 nations that came into existence after the [[Hundred Years War]]. It weakened thereafter and its last traces vanished around the year {{ne|500}}.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Caralain}} It was located in the [[Caralain Grass]]. The country lay to the north of Andor.
